brief.10.lamp: Blackout tonight! You can't see or freeze in the dark. New: spread your fingers, palm out, to light a lantern.
brief.2.candy: Pick up dropped candy and put it back in the pumpkin pail. Dizzy monsters can be grabbed anytime.
brief.2.shake: New: thieves run off hugging candy. Freeze one, pinch it up and shake hard to drop the candy.
brief.3.pull: Too far to reach? Stare at it and pinch. It'll fly right to your hand.
brief.3.throw: Cauldron full? Don't wait around: pinch and fling to toss them far.
brief.4.launch: New trick: pinch and hold until it glows, then FLING! It sails out the gate and becomes a star.
brief.5.pray: New skill: press your palms together. Everything freezes, then slows down. Use it when they swarm.
brief.7.sweep: New skill: hands at your chest, then sweep them apart fast. A gust blows every nearby monster away.
brief.9.shield: New skill: palms down over the pail, push down together. Moonlight will shield it.

hint.frankLift: Lifted! Throw him hard, or give him a shake.

hint.pray: Can't keep up? Press your palms together. Everything freezes, then slows.
hint.lampMove: Pinch the lantern to move it where you need light.
hint.shake: It's hugging candy! Shake it hard.
hint.slip: It's moving, too slippery! Freeze it with your eyes first.
hint.slipPumpkin: Don't stare at Jack! Look beside him and keep him in your side vision.
hint.split: It split! Boolets are fast, freeze them quick.
hint.stealSeen: It got some candy! Pinch it and shake.

lesson.1.cauldron: Drop it in the cauldron on your right. It'll slowly digest it.
lesson.1.grab: While it's frozen, pinch it with thumb and finger. Moving ones slip away!
lesson.1.look: It's Halloween, and the Skellies want your candy. Look at one. While you stare, it can't move.
lesson.1.residual: Look away. It stays frozen a bit longer, until the ring at its feet runs out.

practice.name: Practice
practice.launch: Another one: pinch and hold still till it glows gold, then fling!
say.cauldronRim: Cauldron's full. {kind} waits on the rim and drops in when there's room.
hint.bucketHeavy: The pail is heavy. You can only lift it for a moment.
brief.6.ghost: Boo splits into three little ghosts, one cauldron slot each. If it's nearly full, freeze them first.
brief.8.spider: Spiders drop from the pergola. Look up to freeze one, then reach out and pinch to pull it down.
brief.11.cat: Black cats join tonight and only show in light. Set a lantern by the pail and rotate your skills.
practice.residual: Look away: it stays frozen a bit. Stare longer, it stays longer
practice.pat: Pat down over the cauldron to make it digest faster
practice.bucket: Pinch the pail's handle to lift it
practice.pot: Pinch a cauldron handle to move it somewhere handy
practice.shake: It's carrying candy! Freeze it, pinch it, and shake it side to side
practice.candy: Put the dropped candy back in the pail
practice.pull: That far one: look at it, reach out and pinch, and it flies to you
practice.throw: Pinch it and fling hard to toss it away
practice.pray: Press your palms together: everything freezes
practice.sweep: Hands at your chest, then sweep them apart fast
practice.shield: Palms down over the pail, push down together
practice.lamp: Spread your fingers, back of hand to you, hold still to light a lantern
practice.done: You've got it! Off to guard the night.
tip.potFull: When the cauldron's full, fling them far or wait for one to glow gold. Don't just hold on.
tip.pull: You don't need to wait: stare, then pinch from a distance.
tip.pray: When they swarm, press your palms together to freeze everyone for 3 seconds.
tip.sweep: Sweep both hands out to blow them all off the table.
tip.dark: Light a lantern first and move it by the pail — then cats can't hide in the dark.
tip.star: Pinch and hold still. Wait for it to glow gold, then fling far.
tip.residual: Stare then look away — it stays frozen longer the longer you stare.
result.failFew: Dawn came, but only {n} candy left...
hint.pumpkinRun: Stare too long and Pumpkin Head runs. Glance away, keep it in the corner of your eye, or aim and pinch to pull it.
